sources.excerpt: Ratzo Published on March 19, 2008 Absolutely Analog distortion pedal Information Absolutely Analog Absolutely Analog's "Ratzo" - Picture the original black box with some major improvements. We used metal film capacitors in place of ceramic caps to improve fidelity and lower the background noise floor. The unit has a hand picked LM308 opamp (the real deal) and sounds fantastic! All component upgrades are just better parts. True bypass is built in with an LED indicator. It's housed in a smaller 2.25x4.25 inch industrial strength aluminum enclosure with a beautiful yellow baked on powder coat finish and has an industry standard 9 volt power supply jack on the side or you can use a battery. This effect is perfect for pedal board placement. Cutting edge, sustain for days. The tone of legends in a brand new box! It gets no better than this!
